<section class="page-hero"><h1>Travaux de terrain et pèlerinages</h1></section>
<main class="content"><div class="content-inner fieldwork-index">
<p class="lead">Notes de terrain, visites de monastères, monuments et sites archéologiques, itinéraires de recherche et pèlerinages.</p>
<section class="fieldwork-index-section"><h2>Lieux visités</h2><ul class="fieldwork-place-list"><li><a href="/fr/terrain-pelerinages/sakya/"><strong>Monastère de Sakya</strong></a> <span>— Tibet · Tsang</span></li><li><a href="/fr/terrain-pelerinages/mont-hiei/"><strong>Mont Hiei</strong></a> <span>— Japon · Kyōto / Ōtsu</span></li><li><a href="/fr/terrain-pelerinages/rice-university-houston/"><strong>Rice University, Houston, Texas</strong></a> <span>— États-Unis · Houston, Texas</span></li></ul></section>
<section class="fieldwork-index-section"><h2>Carte</h2><div id="fieldwork-map" style="height:430px;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;margin:1rem 0 2.5rem"></div></section>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css" crossorigin="">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js" crossorigin=""></script>
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded",function(){
  const m=L.map("fieldwork-map");
  L.tileLayer("https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png",{maxZoom:18,attribution:"&copy; OpenStreetMap contributors"}).addTo(m);
  const bounds=[];
  function addMarker(coords,html){L.marker(coords).addTo(m).bindPopup(html);bounds.push(coords);}
  addMarker([28.905,88.018],document.querySelector('.fieldwork-place-list a[href*="/sakya/"]').innerHTML+'<br>'+document.querySelector('.fieldwork-place-list a[href*="/sakya/"]').nextElementSibling.textContent.replace(/^—\s*/,'')+'<br><a href="'+document.querySelector('.fieldwork-place-list a[href*="/sakya/"]').getAttribute('href')+'">Voir le récit</a>');
  addMarker([35.07068,135.84139],'<strong>Mont Hiei</strong><br>Japon · Kyōto / Ōtsu<br><a href="/fr/terrain-pelerinages/mont-hiei/">Voir le récit</a>');
  addMarker([29.7174,-95.4018],'<strong>Rice University, Houston, Texas</strong><br>États-Unis · Houston, Texas<br><a href="/fr/terrain-pelerinages/rice-university-houston/">Voir le récit</a>');
  m.fitBounds(bounds,{padding:[35,35],maxZoom:5});
});
</script>
